mutants.note: The first weight band excludes a package weighing exactly its upper limit; a boundary test must preserve the inclusive edge.
Unknown zones use zone 4 instead of the documented fallback zone; a test must inspect both the normalized zone and quote.
Fuel is rounded before it is added to the service-adjusted base; a test must pin the calculation order at a fractional-cent case.
Leap day is removed from the holiday calendar; a test must exercise February 29 in a leap year.
Zero weight is rejected along with negative weight; a test must distinguish the valid zero boundary from the error path.
A reusable calculator does not clear surcharge labels between quotes; a test must make consecutive calls with different flags.
The next-business-day helper starts two calendar days ahead; a test must check an ordinary weekday.
A postal value that normalizes to empty text is accepted; a test must cover the label validation branch.
The command line returns success after a rate input error; a test must assert the error status.
Currency formatting rounds half cents down instead of using the established half-up rule; a test must use a half-cent value.
